description: Extracts a signal's rate of change by comparing each sample against the one before it, with gates and triggers for the direction of travel

params.text: Multiplies the rate of change before it reaches the Delta output, from x1 to x8000; slow signals need a great deal of it and audio-rate signals almost none
Attenuverts the CV that shifts the boost, -1 to +1

inputs.text: The signal whose rate of change is measured
Shifts the boost, through its own attenuverter

outputs.text: 10V for as long as the input is rising
A 1ms trigger at 10V each time the input starts rising
10V for as long as the input is falling
A 1ms trigger at 10V each time the input starts falling
A 1ms trigger at 10V each time the input changes direction, the sum of the two trigger outputs
The rate of change multiplied by the boost, clipped between -5V and 5V
